entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back right now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's both! It doesn't work the way it's supposed to. The whole interface is so `confusing` and it's incredibly `hard to use`. Frankly, for the price, I `expected more`. A lot more. This is unacceptable.
I understand your frustration. Sometimes there can be a bit of a learning curve. Did you have a chance to look at the setup guide?

The `user manual`? Are you kidding me? It's useless! Look, I'm not an idiot, I know how to use technology. This thing is just poorly designed. I've had it for weeks and I still can't get it right. I want to speak to your manager. Now.
I am empowered to handle this for you, I assure you. Let me just pull up your order. I see you purchased it on December 15th. I just need to verify the return eligibility.
Don't give me the runaround! You're going to process this return or I swear I will post a review on every single website I can find about this terrible product and VeloFit's awful service.
That won't be necessary, sir. One moment while I check the policy... Okay, yes. I see here that you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. You can? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label and sending it to the email address on your account right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Okay. Well... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The email has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
